name: Dungeon Crawl
description: Standalone game application with Rust Host supervised GPU handoff and Ariadne recovery.
author: Ariadne Core

hardware_requirements.gpu: Exclusive workload handoff; no Ollama model required

health.detail: Launched and monitored by Rust Host; application data remains independent.

workspace.startup: Rust Host acquires exclusive GPU ownership, launches Dungeon and waits for its readiness signal.
workspace.readiness: Dungeon HTTP health and fresh startup progress must both confirm readiness.
workspace.shutdown: Rust Host detects process exit or explicit shutdown and releases the workload lease.
workspace.recovery: Failed launch or unhealthy process triggers Host recovery and normal Ollama reconciliation.
